julesThoughtProcess: I chose a vibrant ember-orange (#FF7A00) to represent the grounded optimism of this technofuturistic setting. It evokes the warmth of a shared fire or a neon sign piercing through the fog, standing out as a beacon of resilience and quiet connection against the metallic backdrop of the city.
storyPanel: The mag-lev trains rattled overhead, shaking dust loose from the neon signs of the Under-Market. It wasn't perfect down here, but it was home. An augmented street vendor handed over a steaming bowl of synth-noodles, the mechanical whir of his arm barely audible over the hum of the city. We trade stories of rusted tech and hard-won repairs, finding warmth in the glow of the ember-orange lights. There's grit in the air, sure, but there's also life, vibrant and unyielding.
